saturation.reason: The independent full-corpus sweep found two new current actionable opportunities that were not present in the previous audit corpus or in the reference Radar snapshot: EIT Urban Mobility RIS Education Open Call 2027 and the EUI Permanent Call for peer reviewers. A same-day Toscana reopening for Nidi gratis also requires lifecycle monitoring, but is not counted retroactively as a detection failure because its publication time relative to the reference snapshot is unresolved.

method.seedPolicy: Previous audit waves were not used as the discovery seed. External institutional oracles were searched first; prior waves and the Radar snapshot were consulted only after candidates surfaced, for deduplication and classification.
oracleFamilies: European Commission Funding & Tenders / programme and mission directories
CINEA / EISMEA / EACEA and Commission DG programme pages
EIT opportunity directories and EIT Urban Mobility

newCurrentFindings.title: EIT Urban Mobility · RIS Education Open Call 2027
newCurrentFindings.funding: Approx. EUR 2.6 million total indicative EIT funding; up to EUR 300,000 per project for RISE1 and RISE2, EUR 180,000 for RISE3, EUR 140,000 for RISE4 and EUR 70,000 for RISE5.
newCurrentFindings.eligibilityEvidence: The call explicitly lists cities among legal entities that may apply. Mono-beneficiary proposals are permitted when the applicant is established in an EIT RIS country. Italy is listed among countries eligible to take part in EIT RIS in 2026. Applicants must demonstrate expertise and previous experience in urban-mobility and/or innovation/entrepreneurship capacity building.

newCurrentFindings.title: European Urban Initiative · Permanent Call for peer reviewers
newCurrentFindings.funding: Non-cash EUI capacity-building and peer-learning participation; the Peer Review activity is financed by EUI according to the call guidance.
newCurrentFindings.eligibilityEvidence: Peer reviewers apply as individuals, can represent any EU urban authority, must have relevant experience in integrated place-based strategies, and require endorsement by the represented urban authority. The call is continuously open.

newCurrentFindings.title: Regione Toscana · Nidi gratis 2026-2027 · riapertura candidature dei Comuni
newCurrentFindings.eligibilityEvidence: New municipalities not yet participating can request access credentials by 25 September 2026; municipalities already admitted must transmit the required documentation by PEC by 6 October 2026.
newCurrentFindings.timingCaveat: The official page is dated 7 September 2026, the same date as the reference snapshot. No publication time was established, so the audit does not claim that the reopening was necessarily discoverable before the snapshot was generated at 09:35 UTC.

missionAdaptationControls.title: National Adaptation Hubs - Bringing together the national level with the engaged regional and local levels
missionAdaptationControls.note: The topic is designed around national adaptation hubs and can use FSTP to establish/animate hubs. It is relevant to regional/local actors but does not justify automatic promotion of every municipality as a direct main-call opportunity.

missionAdaptationControls.title: Facilitating implementation of actionable solutions for climate adaptation of regions and local authorities
missionAdaptationControls.note: The Work Programme makes regional and local authorities the target audience/customers while stating they are not expected to participate in the consortium.

missionAdaptationControls.title: Standardising and supporting climate services for climate adaptation
missionAdaptationControls.note: No mandatory municipality-beneficiary role was established in this independent pass.

missionAdaptationControls.title: Bridging the gap between disaster risk management and climate adaptation
missionAdaptationControls.note: The topic develops guidance and recommendations for regional/local authorities and multi-level resilience, but no universal municipality-beneficiary condition was established.
Previously documented in the audit corpus; rediscovered independently and therefore treated as a positive oracle control.

missionAdaptationControls.title: Improving climate resilience of navigable inland waterways, their surroundings and related water infrastructure
missionAdaptationControls.note: No direct seven-municipality applicability was established without a qualifying navigable inland-waterway/infrastructure role.
Previously documented; local/regional administrations are potential downstream FSTP recipients rather than generic main-call applicants.

currentScopeControls.title: CEF Energy · 6th call for Cross-Border Renewable Energy Projects to obtain CB RES status
currentScopeControls.note: Obtaining CB RES status is a prerequisite for later CEF Energy support for studies/works. This is not a generic municipal opportunity; relevance requires a qualifying cross-border renewable-energy project and cooperation arrangement.

historicalOrClosedControls.note: Municipal/city civil servants were relevant and RIS scholarships existed, but the two 2026 application rounds closed on 13 May and 8 July.

historicalOrClosedControls.title: I3 Capacity Building 2026
historicalOrClosedControls.note: Public authorities and capacity-building ecosystems are relevant, but the 2026 call closed on 19 March 2026 and therefore is not a current gap on 8 September.
The programme targeted Covenant Coordinators/Supporters rather than generic municipalities and closed in May 2026.

geographicOrEligibilityControls.note: The current fourth call does not include Lucca/Tuscany in the eligible Italian programme area.

prospectiveControls.note: The call is not open on the audit date. Municipalities, foundations and associations can be eligible when they organise a qualifying historic carnival. For Viareggio, direct municipal applicability must distinguish the Comune from Fondazione Carnevale di Viareggio as the organising entity.
The 2026 cycle has been rescheduled later than the earlier indicative calendar and is not treated as a current runtime miss on 8 September.

conclusion.nextAction: Do not harden the engine yet. Absorb Wave 12 findings into the audit corpus, then run another independent full-corpus sweep from different oracle paths only after this corpus update; a clean sweep cannot be counted until no new current actionable opportunity is found.
